fuel_exhaustion_guard.policy: Retain Draft3A nocharge/dischargewithinouterhour constraint. If remainingfuel cannot sustain the predicted positiveDG operation to the end of this hour, inhibitDG-to-BESS charging for thathour, dump remaining minimum-load surplus in existing25kW sink, and letBESS bridge post-exhaustion load. No fuel, capacity or startup parameter is changed.
fuel_exhaustion_guard.scope: Conservative documented controller safeguard at finite-fuel exhaustion only; not a change to frozen Draft3A or real hardware certification
